fact: As of May 2026 Malawi's school data systems are described as fragmented and paper-based: schools keep multiple manual registers (class attendance and performance register, master enrolment register, admission register), the Ministry no longer supplies standardised registers, and EMIS cohort tracking, which assigns Learner Identification Numbers on entry, has rarely been analysed since 2012 and is recommended for digitisation.
title: From Data Collection to Data Use: Strengthening decision-making at subnational levels in Malawi
